Near-field wireless. Far-reaching possibilities.

I study how the physics of wireless propagation can shape more efficient and secure 6G networks. My work brings together antenna design, beamforming, and resource optimization.

01 / Research directions

Shaping the next wireless frontier.

From reconfigurable apertures to energy-aware links, I connect physical channel models with practical optimization methods.

01

PASS / NEAR FIELD

Reconfigurable antennas

Joint antenna-position and beam design for pinching-antenna systems, with a focus on multi-waveguide multicast, sustainable networks, and covert communication.

  • Pinching antennas
  • Beamforming
  • Multicast
02

SECURITY / ENERGY

Secure, energy-aware networks

Physical-layer security for non-orthogonal multiple access and extremely large-scale arrays, combining confidential communication with wireless energy harvesting.

  • NOMA
  • SWIPT
  • ELAA
03

RIS / SIM

Intelligent wireless surfaces

Resource allocation for reconfigurable and stacked intelligent surfaces, balancing power, phase, position, reliability, and short-packet delay.

  • Intelligent surfaces
  • Holographic RIS
  • Optimization
